pedestrian_crossing_intention_qa.Question: Will the pedestrian located at [1948, 974, 1998, 1091] in frame 1 cross the road? Justify your answer with spatial, temporal, mathematical, ego-vehicle, and scene-context reasoning. Conclude the pedestrian’s motives.

pedestrian_crossing_intention_qa.Temporal_Reason: Throughout all 10 frames, the pedestrian maintains their 'walking' action but shows minimal lateral displacement, staying within the same general area without transitioning toward road-crossing behavior or stepping toward the curb edge.

pedestrian_crossing_intention_qa.Conclusion: The pedestrian will not cross the road because they are walking parallel to the sidewalk, showing no signs of turning toward the street, and their steady pace alongside the road indicates they are simply traveling along their current path.
